Meghna Agarwal
Talent Acquisition Specialist | Whitefield, Bangalore
meghna.agarwal160@example.com | +91 9139968156

Experienced Talent Acquisition Specialist with a strong technical recruitment background and hands-on experience managing end-to-end hiring and onboarding processes for fast-growing product and operations teams. Combines data-driven sourcing using LinkedIn Recruiter with operational coordination in onboarding, and familiarity with technical stacks to improve candidate evaluation and time-to-hire metrics.

Experience
Zoho — Apr 2025 - Present
Talent Acquisition Specialist (Hybrid)
- Managed full-cycle Recruitment for product and support teams, sourcing 120+ candidates via LinkedIn Recruiter and internal pipelines, resulting in 38 hires in first 9 months and reducing time-to-fill from 42 to 30 days.
- Designed and ran structured Onboarding workflows using Jira to track tasks across hiring managers and HR, improving new-hire 30-day completion rate to 98%.
- Collaborated with engineering leads to evaluate technical candidates, leveraging candidate familiarity with Linux and Git in screening criteria and improving quality-of-hire metric by 15%.
- Implemented candidate experience improvements (automated status updates and feedback templates), increasing offer-acceptance rate from 72% to 84%.

Swiggy — Nov 2022 - Mar 2025
Talent Acquisition Specialist (Remote)
- Conducted high-volume Talent Acquisition for operations, customer experience, and mid-level engineering roles, sourcing primarily via LinkedIn Recruiter and referred networks to fill 210 roles over 28 months.
- Streamlined Onboarding checklists and coordinated handoffs using Jira, reducing onboarding slip-ups by 40% and cutting average ramp time by 12%.
- Partnered with recruiters and hiring managers to refine role briefs and interview scorecards focused on practical skills; incorporated Linux and Git competency checks for technical operations hires.
- Maintained recruitment dashboards and candidate pipelines, improving monthly hiring velocity and lowering cost-per-hire through targeted sourcing strategies.

Projects
- Onboarding Automation Project: Led a cross-functional initiative to create Jira-based onboarding templates and automated reminders, reducing manual follow-ups by 60% and ensuring consistent documentation for every new hire.
- Candidate Sourcing Toolkit: Compiled reusable LinkedIn Recruiter boolean strings and outreach templates tailored to product and operations roles, accelerating initial screening response rate by 28%.

Skills
Recruitment: Recruitment, Talent Acquisition, LinkedIn Recruiter
Onboarding & Tools: Onboarding, Jira
Technical: Linux, Git

Education
